scenes.name: agent-bell
scenes.title: Agent bell
scenes.author: Marco Porro
scenes.description: A lantern for each AI agent, coloured by its state. When one starts waiting for you, a bell appears, rings and chimes; click it (or answer the agent) and it goes away. Lightning when an agent fails, a shooting star when one finishes.

scenes.name: container-aquarium
scenes.title: Container aquarium
scenes.author: Marco Porro
scenes.description: A fish for every container of your docker panel (the docker community source), green when it is up, amber when unhealthy, red when it stopped. Bubbles follow your network. A container goes down: the glass flashes red and lightning strikes. Click a fish: its name.

scenes.name: green-build-rocket
scenes.title: Green build rocket
scenes.author: Marco Porro
scenes.description: A rocket of your own on its launch pad. CI passes again: it lifts off with Pulse's own rocket. CI fails: it flashes red, and the light on the tower turns red while a build is failing. Smoke follows your agents at work; stars come out when the Sun goes down. Click it to launch it.

scenes.name: homelab-tower
scenes.title: Homelab tower
scenes.author: Marco Porro
scenes.description: A server rack that grows with the power your homelab draws (a panel called "power"), with heat rising off it and a beacon on top. Click it: it shakes and says the power. CI fails: it flashes red. Over 4 kW: a balloon tells you.

scenes.name: moonlit-garden
scenes.title: Moonlit garden
scenes.author: Marco Porro
scenes.description: A night garden: a flower for every repo, its colour the CI, its size the commits of the week; fireflies for the agents at work; a Moon as bright as the real one; stars when the Sun is down. Fireworks at midnight, a shooting star when the ISS passes over.
